acceptanceCriteria: Every explicitly supplied filter value absent from its index returns an empty result immediately and reports zero candidate record access, even when another filter has many candidates.
Existing conjunctive exact-filter behavior and stable ordering remain unchanged.
A real CLI knowledge query measurement records cold and warm latency on a fixed fixture, with raw samples and honest p50/p95 availability.
The measurement separates cache validation cost from candidate access and records read-byte and resident-memory metrics when the host exposes them; unavailable metrics carry an explicit reason.
Cache integrity and source-digest validation remain unchanged; no release or public version claim is made.
The CLI query output exposes additive projection and query timing/candidate-access metrics used by the real benchmark without changing the existing result contract.
goal: Short-circuit impossible indexed filters and produce evidence-separated cold/warm CLI query measurements.
intent: Close the remaining knowledge query performance gap without weakening cache trust.
